# Security

Do not submit passwords, access tokens, SSH private keys, private-key passphrases, or confidential server details in issues or pull requests.

ChemAuto stores only non-sensitive remote profile parameters. Passwords and private-key passphrases are requested by OpenSSH in a separate console and are not written to ChemAuto configuration files.

To report a security issue, contact the repository owner privately through the contact method associated with the GitHub account rather than opening a public issue.
